clips.objective: After this, a child in 7-10 can locate the zero line on a map, shown by a correct pin on the Royal Observatory at Greenwich.
clips.why: Where is the line maps call zero?

stretch.question: A full turn is 360 degrees. The clock day has 24 hours. How many degrees is one hour?

clips.objective: After this, a child in 7-10 can compute how many years ago 1830 was, shown by tapping the device year minus 1830.
clips.why: How many years ago did a steam railway join Liverpool and Manchester?

retrieval.question: The railway opened in 1830. How many years ago is that?

stretch.question: In an 1829 trial the Rocket went 36 miles in one hour. At that speed, how many miles in 2 hours?

clips.objective: After this, a child in 7-10 can locate where the 1866 cable came ashore, shown by a correct pin on Heart's Content.
clips.why: A message once crossed under the Atlantic from Ireland. Find the place in Newfoundland where the cable came ashore.

place.name: Heart's Content Cable Station, Newfoundland and Labrador

retrieval.question: Where did the 1866 cable come ashore in Newfoundland?

stretch.question: 1,852 miles of cable were laid in 14 days. Which is closest to the miles per day: 100, 130, or 200?
